command.slimvehicle.help: RMB — part; Shift+RMB — get in; R — engine; Z/X — gears; H — lights; G — horn; B — handbrake; K — lock (with the key, from up to 32 blocks away; RMB with the key does the same); J — window; V — siren; M — radio, . and , — stations; Y — wipers. Repair kit: RMB on the vehicle. /slimvehicle spawn, key, trust, revoke, tint, paint, repair, condition, remove, packs, radio
